integrity: The proof conditions on the complete reflected path and uses the exact symmetry of excursion signs. The local-time variance is derived independently from return probabilities and a central-binomial convolution identity. Exhaustive path enumeration checks finite cases but is not used as proof of the all-horizon statement.
scientific_limitations: The exact conditional slope uses the one-dimensional simple symmetric random walk and strict positive occupation time.
The theorem does not assert independence between zero local time and signed occupation imbalance.
An equivalent elementary excursion-sign identity may exist in older unindexed fluctuation-theory literature under another occupation-time convention.
title: Exact finite regression of positive occupation on zero local time
